Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #28928 dev (PR #29064, os-dev-report 6570874270 on #28928), also the should-fix of that PR's contract review. Filed by `domain:server` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. Graded by this seat p3 under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01): refusal text that names the wrong cause; the outcome is right.

Reach: an admin running the datasource credential migration (drop-inline) over a credential whose `sys_secret` row decrypts to an empty value (rows sealed before PR #29064).

## Where (at PR #29064's head `66a746c6`)

`migrateCredential` in `packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-admin-service.ts` (about L1179) refuses on `resolved == null || resolved === ''` with one sentence that blames a missing row or a changed encryption key. PR #29064 already split the connect path's status reason (an empty credential is named as empty); this refusal still conflates the two.

## Wanted

The empty-value branch names the credential as empty, in PR #29064's wording; the missing-row / changed-key branch keeps its sentence. Same status and code; a test pins both texts.

Dedupe: searched `migrateCredential empty secret`, `drop-inline credential missing row`. Related: #28928 / PR #29064. **New.**
